name: Amazing CRE
verdict: Korean golfwear brand run by AMCR, acquired in 2024 by a consortium led by Grande Clip, the company builder of Baedal Minjok founder Kim Bong-jin. Nothing found.
note: Korean Golf Club's performance apparel partner for the 2026 LIV Golf season (livgolf.com announcement, 2026-02-02). Partner logo links to a collection on sokimnewyork.com, a New York retailer stocking the brand. Quick company check (2026-10-03): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against AMCR, AmazingCre or Grande Clip found.
